description: Reserve a table by phone: the line calls the venue, negotiates the time, answers the host's questions (name, callback, email), records policies, and never pays. Give the venue's phone number, party size, date/time, and the acceptable window or fallbacks. Returns reservation_id and call_id; read the outcome with get_call or list_reservations before telling the owner anything is confirmed. Statuses: confirmed, alternative_confirmed, waitlisted, hold, requires_online, needs_owner, callback_later, no_availability, declined_by_venue, voicemail, not_reached.

date.description: 'Friday', 'tomorrow', '9/12', or '2026-09-12'. Resolved in the owner's timezone.

name.description: Name for the booking; defaults to the owner.

notes.description: Anything else the host might ask: high chair, accessibility, corkage.

owner_phone_ok.description: Allow giving the owner's mobile as the reservation contact (default: the line's number and email).

time.description: e.g. '7:30pm'. 5–11 without am/pm is treated as evening.

name: book_reservation
title: Book a restaurant reservation
